title: Full boundary refresh on a sloping block
summary: Replaced tired timber fencing with Monument Colorbond on three sides, stepping panels down a 900mm fall.
challenge: The block falls nearly a metre front to back, and two neighbours needed to agree on colour and cost-sharing.
outcome: We used plinths to keep the top line stepped evenly, handled both dividing-fence agreements, and finished a day ahead of schedule.

image.alt: Backyard with table, chairs and umbrella inside a fenced yard

title: Frameless glass for a coastal holiday home
summary: 12mm frameless glass with 316 marine-grade spigots and a soft-close hinge gate.
challenge: Salt air and a timber deck meant standard spigots and fixings would corrode within a few years.
outcome: Core-drilled 316 spigots into new concrete footings beneath the deck. Passed the shire inspection first time.

image.alt: Swimming pool with a building in the background

title: Estate-approved slat frontage & sliding gate
summary: Custom 90mm Monument slats with a matching automated sliding driveway gate.
challenge: The estate required 50% visual permeability and a maximum 1.2m front fence height.
outcome: We designed 20mm gaps to meet the permeability rule and submitted drawings for approval within 48 hours.

image.alt: Modern house with a landscaped front yard

title: 420m Garrison fence for a logistics yard
summary: 2.4m black Garrison fencing with two 10m cantilever sliding gates and access control.
challenge: The yard had to stay fully operational with trucks moving 24/7.
outcome: We staged the install in four zones with traffic management and completed without a single hour of downtime.

image.alt: Brick industrial building behind a steel gate

title: App-controlled sliding gate retrofit
summary: Replaced a sagging timber swing gate with an aluminium sliding gate and Centurion D5 Smart motor.
challenge: A steep driveway meant a swing gate kept dragging on the concrete.
outcome: A level track and sliding gate solved the drag permanently, and the owners now open it from their phone.

image.alt: Driveway gate at the front of a home

title: Retaining + fence combo on a new build
summary: 600mm concrete sleeper retaining wall with 1.8m Colorbond fencing on top.
challenge: The builder's site levels left a 600mm drop to the neighbour, with no fence allowed until retaining was done.
outcome: One crew did both, with ag-pipe drainage and plinth-free panels sitting flush on the wall.
